project_guidance.title: Welsh driveway and drainage checks
project_guidance.intro: Use this starting point with the full official guidance and the planning history for your address.
rules: New or replacement front hard surfacing must be permeable or drain to a permeable area at the front of the home.
A repair to an existing area up to 5 square metres is treated separately. Significant earthworks and listed buildings need closer checks.
